Main-only source integration

The October 19 pass reconciles preserved contributions without replacing the guided workspace with older broad tool screens. Four maximal task histories carry packaging/payload acquisition, converters and durable queues, native file operations and companion consumers. Separate real merges retain the optional native-container backend and patch-equivalent documentation history. All 77 actual fetched non-main tips are ancestors of the integrated source.

Behavior and authority

Current ISO policy, durable submission correlation, runtime ownership and cancellation remain in the existing host validation path. The optional backend remains internal and inactive; source import grants no renderer authority and proves no live firmware build. Installer resources retain physical offline documentation alongside admitted payloads and native helpers.

Tools feedback stays attached to its initiating task and action. Cancellation, pause and history export use the same records as ordinary actions. Disconnecting invalidates navigation and clears the queue timer. Conversion/PDF primary actions follow available or explicitly attemptable adapters.

Verification and failure boundaries

Strict renderer checking exits zero at 3be630d. Nine real-class feedback checks failed against the preceding source and passed after repair; these fixtures are not native input proof. Unknown project replies are validated before list iteration, object access and document export. Missing desktop callbacks stay unavailable.

Timing requires exact successful publication before measuring a release. A preservation build with one skipped publication step and one successful eligibility step records no-publication evidence without reading/editing a release. Retirement push events skip production and their labelled completion events skip timing annotation. Ordinary branch pushes and manual production retain their paths.

Final root builds, runtime observations, remote proof and retirement results are recorded in HANDOFF.md as they finish. Source integration never proves whole-product acceptance, firmware/device operations, fresh-host installation or installed update.

Final installer resource preservation

The genuine embedding observer now retains its exact input ZIP before the packaging tool edits executable resources. Finalization verifies that input and both compiled helper identities, invokes the unchanged genuine helper after resource editing, and retains separate source-bound invocation evidence. Existing final package, updater, feed and embedded-resource hash checks still decide admission. A kill-on-close Job Object owns the suspended helper before execution, with bounded waiting and termination so a timed-out observer cannot leave a child writing the output.

Four focused checks pass, including exact transfer-boundary and changed-input rejection cases plus a static containment check with four mutation negatives. The supported MSVC compilation passed. Actual native fixture execution returned EACCES before either the observer or unchanged genuine helper started, across three bounded attempts. Positive native embedding and runtime termination remain unverified. The retained native fixture is explicit opt-in evidence, not a passing default test. No security setting was changed.

The hard per-file installer transfer ceiling is 1,450,000,000 bytes, retaining 50 MB below the 1.5 GB transport limit. Exact ceiling and ceiling-plus-one cases are checked. The smaller optional diagnostic-collection budget remains separate and does not limit the normal release transport.

Retirement checkpoint

All 77 actual non-main remote branches and two completed task worktrees/local branches have been retired after fresh ancestry proof against remote main at b10f6eb. The earlier count of 78 included the symbolic remote HEAD alias. The primary checkout remains clean with only local and remote main. The source archive passed full integrity testing before deletion, and ignored generated images were separately preserved.

The full local host inventory passed 716 checks with zero failures and 16 explicit skips. All 33 selected renderer checks passed. Exact desktop production at 4c5e9ec and documentation production at b10f6eb passed. Documentation checks covered 433 HTML pages and 11,315 internal links/assets/fragments. Two current native screenshots and their bounded evidence appear in the main overview, with exact identities in the capture inventory. Native navigation is bounded; catalog loading and image/reference interaction remain unverified. Installer retry 39207625084 failed its final embedded ZIP admission check, after passing the repaired cross-volume staging path. No release was published by that run.
